Welcome to the Nom Nom family—happy to walk you through it!

Sign up & trial: When you join, we create a personalized plan and start you on a 2-week trial, then orders ship every 4 weeks (you can change or cancel anytime before the order deadline).
Unpack your first box:
Carefully open the box and lift the liner flap.
If you see any dry ice, leave it in the box in a well‑ventilated area until it disappears—don’t touch it with bare hands.
Once the dry ice is gone, move meals to the freezer, and put a couple in the fridge to start serving.
Transition the food: Begin by mixing about 25% Nom Nom with 75% of your dog’s current food, then slowly increase Nom Nom over the week so their tummy adjusts.
Use your account: In your online account, you can manage what’s in your order, delivery timing and address, and payment details so your pup never runs out.

That’s really the flow: sign up, unpack, transition slowly, and manage everything from your account.

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here are the main options in simple terms:

Trial & subscription: You start with a 2‑week trial, then orders ship every 4 weeks on a recurring basis.
Manage your account: In your online account you can change what’s in your order, delivery timing/address, and payment details.
Meal plan controls: On the Pets page you can:
Pick or change recipes and choose to get the same ones every time (Fixed) or switch each order (Rotate).
Choose portion size (full portions or half portions to mix with other food).
Set how many meal packs per day your dog gets.
Activity & portions: Set your dog’s activity level (Average, Active, Athlete) so we can size meals correctly, and check the Feeding Guide for exactly how much to serve.
Add or remove dogs: You can add new dogs and build separate meal plans for each. Removing a dog currently requires chatting with a Pet Support Specialist, and changes can affect pricing.
Extras: From the Extras page, you can add treats and probiotics as a one‑time add‑on or in every box.
Costs & discounts: Price depends on your dog’s details and chosen recipes; First Responders and Military Veterans can apply for a discount.
Retail options & samples: If you don’t want a subscription, you can buy our recipes, treats, and probiotics through partners like Chewy, Amazon, and PetSmart, including variety packs and single packs for sampling.

All of this lives in your Nom Nom account, and most changes just need to be made before your order deadline so they apply to your next box.
